sentences.text: Also heard on IA No. 853 of 2023, which is an application under Section 389 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of the appellant-Pappulal for grant of bail and suspension of remaining jail sentence.

Appellant has been convicted for the offence under Section 366 and 376(2)(n) of IPC and sentenced to 5 years R.I. with fine of Rs.1,000/-, and 10 years RI with fine of Rs. 5,000/- with usual default stipulation.
It is submitted that the appellant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this matter.
The appellant is 28 years of age and he is sole butter earner of his family.
He has suffered jail incarceration of 462 days.
There is a strong case in favour of the appellant.
Final conclusion of appeal will take a long sufficient time.
Hence it is prayed that the appellant be enlarged on bail and his remaining jail sentence be suspended till the final disposal of the appeal.
Per contra, learned GA for the respondent/State opposes the application for suspension of sentence and prays for its rejection.

From perusal of the record it appears that appellant was enlarged on bail but at the stage of final arguments, he remained absent and absconded, therefore, in compliance of arrest warrant, he has been taken into custody.
Hence he has misused the liberty granted to him by the trial court.

The Statement of prosecutrix (PW-1) is well supported by the statement of her father (PW-2), as also missing person report Pappulal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125485127/
1 (Ex.P-17) and DNA report (Ex.P- 20).

entities.text: Pappulal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the evidence available on record, this court is not inclined to suspend the remaining jail sentence of appellant.
Hence IA No. 853 of 2023 filed by appellant under section 389 of Cr.P.C. is hereby rejected.

(ANIL VERMA) JUDGE BDJ Pappulal vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125485127/
